sourceBoundary.input: already-selected root-relative nested sequence description over exact existing occurrences

sequenceSemantics.topLevel: ∞ A B C -> create AB=A⟼B then ABC=AB⟼C
sequenceSemantics.fold: left fold: current=A; for each next value V create current=current⟼V
sequenceSemantics.singleton: one item returns that exact item and creates no relation
sequenceSemantics.nestedGroup: recursively materialize the group and return its exact result as one outer value
sequenceSemantics.multiItemResult: the final exact prefix relation created by the left fold

requiredVectors: source carrier for ∞ab lacks a⟼b before materialization
∞ab creates exactly one new a⟼b occurrence
∞abc creates exactly a⟼b then (a⟼b)⟼c and returns (a⟼b)⟼c
empty top-level and nested sequences return the distinguished exact root without creation
∞[window][cursor][position][[[x][int]][point]] creates XI, Q, W⟼C, (W⟼C)⟼P, ((W⟼C)⟼P)⟼Q in deterministic nested-first order
singleton nested group returns its exact item without a new link
existing equal-pair occurrence is not implicitly reused
find of absent target does not mutate before state
replay rejects forged poles, extra occurrences, wrong result or changed base topology
snapshot round-trip preserves topology but not cross-load runtime identity
historical v0.2 recursive denotation contracts remain unchanged and are not silently replaced
